title: Scalar normalization of the constructed component section map
statement: In the setting of [def-zl-component-section-map], suppose beta is a monoidal natural isomorphism from profinite slice restriction followed by component inverse image to upperStarFromPoint T, and alpha.hom is beta evaluated at Lambda. The constructed componentSectionMap takes every profiniteScalarMap(r) to affineScalarSection(r). No weak contractibility is needed.

proof.text: Represent r by the integer-multiple map from the abelian tensor unit, and transpose it by the constant-sheaf adjunction at the profinite point. Applying slice inverse image and evaluating at 1 is definitionally the restriction defining profiniteScalarMap.

Naturality of β on that map, hα and the monoidal unit equation identify its further inverse image with the map defining affineScalarSection. In the constructed section map the source terminal equivalence cancels its inverse; evaluate the resulting equality of tensor-unit morphisms.

theorem component_section_scalar_normalization
    (α : (componentInverse T).mapMon.obj
      (Mon.mk (profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T))) ≅
      Mon.mk (condensedRingObj Λ.X T))
    (β : (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).overPullback Ab.{u + 1}
      (affineComponentSpace T) ⋙ componentInverse T ≅ upperStarFromPoint T)
    (hβ : NatTrans.IsMonoidal β.hom) (hα : α.hom.hom = β.hom.app Λ.X) :
    ∀ r : condensedScalarRing Λ.X,
      componentSectionMap Λ T α (profiniteScalarMap Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T) r) =
        affineScalarSection Λ.X T r
